findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "regulatory-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: regulatory-intelligence_us-details · Private data: regulatory-intelligence_uk-search, regulatory-intelligence_us-search, regulatory-intelligence_us-details, contact_us · Public sink: contact_us.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: regulatory-intelligence_us-details · Private data: regulatory-intelligence_uk-search, regulatory-intelligence_us-search, regulatory-intelligence_us-details, contact_us · Public sink: contact_us

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "regulatory-intelligence_uk-search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
